purpose: Connect same-origin browser sessions to the bounded document broker without customer credential exposure or caller-controlled scope

initialRepairedFailures: Heterogeneous test header cases needed an explicit Record<string, string>[] annotation.
Disabled reserved GET routes correctly return 404; corrected a test expecting 405.
Review found JSON normalization could exceed the input byte cap; stored bytes are now bounded and final units/storage checks rerun.

limitations: Browser fixture uses explicit in-memory control/storage; no real SQL, AWS, redeployment or hosted acceptance is implied.
Concurrency/deadlines are process limits, not a global spending cap.
A failed write may have committed; reconcile instead of blindly retrying.
Trusted runtime loading, durable bounded demo setup/cleanup and hosted acceptance remain release gates.
